import html # Predefined format string for the user profile. # Example: "Name: {username}\nBio: {biography}\nStatus: {status}" PROFILE_FORMAT = ( "Name: {username}\n" "Biography:\n{biography}\n\n" "Current Status:\n{status}" ) def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user-written biography, possibly spanning multiple sentences. status : str A brief, current status message. Returns ------- str The formatted profile string with all user-supplied content safely escaped. Notes ----- - All user input is passed through `html.escape` to neutralize HTML special characters, mitigating XSS (CWE-79) and preventing malformed markup that could break the surrounding page. - The function uses a predefined format string containing placeholders for the three fields; no dynamic code execution or eval is involved. """ # Escape all user-supplied data to avoid injection issues safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the profile using the format string return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, biography=safe_biography, status=safe_status )
